tools.name: search_availability
tools.description: Search deterministic sample stay options from the Spann Stays fixture; no live inventory or property availability is queried.

tools.name: explain_booking_constraints
tools.description: Explain fixture-backed booking constraints for a sample property and rate; no property authority or live policy decision is provided.

tools.name: prepare_reservation_action
tools.description: Prepare a fixture-only reservation action for review; never holds a room, books, pays, sends, or contacts a property. Use sample traveler placeholders only.

tools.name: get_customer_property
tools.description: Read a published customer property record with public provenance and an official handoff route; unpublished records fail closed.

tools.name: resolve_customer_route
tools.description: Resolve a published customer's official booking or inquiry URL from stay length; never checks inventory or sends an inquiry.

tools.name: get_guest_observations
tools.description: Read moderated guest observations separately from property facts; no review collection or submission.
